mapper.select: select count(*) as value,count(visitors_flow_rate) as visitors_flow_rate, a.omit as regionId, a.city as regionId, b.name from t_platform_org_list a left join t_platform_region b on a.omit=b.id left join t_platform_region b on a.city=b.id where deleted=0 and longitude is not null and latitude is not null GROUP BY omit and omit = #{areaId} GROUP BY city
select visitors_flow_rate,credit_score,organization_name,longitude,latitude,business_status from t_platform_org_list where city=#{areaId} and longitude is not null and latitude is not null
